issues.message: The homepage has a slightly longer load time (972.79 ms) compared to the pricing page (492.59 ms) and blog page (289.79 ms). This difference might be due to additional resources or more complex scripts on the homepage. Recommendation
issues.recommendation: Continuously monitor and optimize the homepage to maintain a fast load time and ensure a positive user experience.

insights: The Time to First Byte (TTFB) metric is relatively low for all pages, indicating that the server response time is fast. This is a positive sign for user experience and SEO.
First Contentful Paint (FCP) is also low for all pages, meaning that the user sees the first piece of content quickly. This is another positive sign for user experience and engagement.

Although the homepage has a longer load time than the other pages, it still falls within an acceptable range (less than 3 seconds). However, it is crucial to keep optimizing the homepage to maintain a fast load time and prevent any potential issues that might arise in the future.
